docs.title: Digital Latin Documentation
docs.text:
Welcome to the Digital Latin documentation site. Use the navigation to explore guides, API reference, and FAQs.

  • For user instructions, see the User Guide.
  • For API details, see the API Reference.
  • For common questions, see the FAQ.

This documentation is powered by MkDocs and the Material theme.

docs.title: About
docs.text:
Digital Latin is a tool for Latin text simplification and instructional support, developed by Harvard ATG.

  • Source: GitHub
  • License: MIT
  • Maintainers: Harvard ATG

This site is generated with MkDocs and the Material theme.

• /score — Main chat scoring endpoint

docs.title: FAQ
docs.text:
Q: How do I start a new session?

A: Click the "New Session" button in the sidebar to reset your chat and begin a new session.

Q: What models are available?

A: The available models are set via environment variables. See the sidebar for your current options.

Q: How do I report a bug or request a feature?

A: Please open an issue on GitHub.

Expand this FAQ as new questions arise.

docs.title: User Guide
docs.text: This is the main user guide for Digital Latin.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
• Launch the app and log in with your credentials.
  • Select a simplification level in the sidebar.
  • Enter your Latin passage or question in the chat input area.
  • Click the send button (➤) to interact with the AI assistant.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Session Management: Start new sessions, save, and load previous chats.
  • Accessibility: Custom CSS for improved navigation and screen reader support.
  • Model Selection: Choose from available AI models as configured by your admin.

docs.title: Tips
docs.text:
• Use the sidebar for navigation and settings.
  • For best results, keep your Latin passages concise.
  • Refer to the FAQ for troubleshooting and common questions.

Expand this guide as new features are added.
